description: [1/5] Plan, architecture ADRs and AIKit reports

impact_assessment.why: Build a unique programmer tool: deterministic, offline fixture generation that makes test data reproducible and reviewable
impact_assessment.benefits: Stable golden fixtures, no network or runtime deps, a dogfooded FC/edge/SM architecture, and an AIKit delivery trail
impact_assessment.risks: contract: generated JSON/CSV bytes are a public API; dependency: Rust std only; concurrency: single-threaded generation; state: schema format versioned and read-only
impact_assessment.mitigation: Golden byte-for-byte tests for PRNG and renderers, std-only build, pure core with explicit GenerateState machine, versioned schema refused on unknown version

description: [2/5] Pure core implemented: versioned schema, xorshift64 stream, generator, JSON/CSV renderers, comparator, explicit machine
[3/5] Imperative shell, Rust compat drivers, GNU linker config, golden fixtures and 21 tests
[4/5] Docs, architecture audit and Phase 4 gate shield: hygiene, guidelines, secrets, compat, test all pass
